children.name: Chazydictya ornata Ernst & Carrera, 2022
children.description: Bifoliate lenticular, branched colony. Branches 1.4 - 2.0 mm wide and 0.6 - 1.0 mm thick. Mesotheca straight, 0.015 to 0.020 mm thick, without median rods. Autozooecia short, tubular, bending sharply to branch surface, rectangular to subrhomboidal at their bases, becoming oval at branch surface, arranged in 12 to 15 regular alternating rows on branches. Rare diaphragms occurring. Autozooecial walls granular, 0.01 to 0.02 mm thick in endozone; thick, finely laminated in exozone. Laminated skeleton well developed. Paurostyles abundant, 0.015 - 0.035 mm in diameter. COMPARISON
